verdict.rationale: Expensify offers a general API with OAuth2 credentials (expensify-docs-1,2,12,19,20) and conversational AI features that can categorize/approve/reject expenses via plain language (expensify-docs-3,4,22), which could underpin an agent-driven coding workflow, but there is no documentation of an MCP server, no endpoint specifically for pulling 'uncoded' transactions, and no described push-back-for-review flow for agent-proposed coding. Missing for 10: MCP server support, a dedicated uncoded-transactions/coding API endpoint, explicit agent review-and-push workflow, and independent validation of categorization accuracy (community reports flag frequent categorization errors, expensify-comm-1, expensify-comm-4).
